corrections.caveats: Enricher: the Criterion closure clones both inputs and allocates and drops the result inside the timed region, which shrinks the gap between steps; which version is timed is set by a compile-time alias, so the safe and unchecked versions only run in separate cargo bench runs (cross-run, probably one machine). No target-cpu flag and no rust-toolchain file. The safe public function never validates shapes, so ragged input reaches the unchecked reads (unsound API, undefined behaviour). The book figure is about 5.6 GFLOPS (derived), far from BLAS.
